caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object, possibly a tin or container, with an illustrated scene on its side. The scene shows a central stone building labeled "CASTLE GARDEN" in capital letters, with a flagpole and an American flag flying above the structure. The building is detailed with domed roofs and symmetrical elements. In the foreground, several human figures are present—some standing, some walking, and some appearing in pairs, suggesting a park or social area. The foreground and sides are framed by stylized trees with curved trunks and rounded brown and green foliage, placing the scene in a landscaped environment. The color palette consists primarily of shades of brown, green, pink, and off-white. At the top edge of the cylinder, there is a decorative band featuring a repeating leaf or vine motif in shades of green and pink. The composition is bordered at the top and bottom by the edge of the cylindrical shape, and the objects within the scene are rendered with simple, flat forms and minimal shading.
title: Bandbox - "Castle Garden"
